role: Read-only 01/05/09 oil curve with inventory-conditioned carry, four listed contracts, an eight-week shared futures-liquidity roll curve, and a reserved mega-institution position and turnover policy.

volume_lots.note: Weekly futures turnover; higher periods sum visible weeks.

reference.monthly.note: Visible spot OHLC only; no futures liquidity or participant-limit fields are added to spot.

mainContinuous.monthly.note: Backward-ratio-adjusted main OHLC; liquidity and current limits come from the active source contract.

curve.contracts[].monthly.note: Named OIL-YYMM price and liquidity history from listing through cutoff or expiry.

invariants: exactly four 01/05/09 delivery-month contracts are listed
funding plus storage plus risk premium minus inventory-conditioned convenience yield forms the persistent long carry target
tight inventory and positive physical flow gaps raise convenience yield and favor backwardation; loose inventory and negative gaps favor contango
all basis components are continuous in time to expiry and equal zero at final settlement
volume and open interest use the same smoothstep progress across the final eight weeks of roll migration
the normal single-contract participant limit is the lesser of 3 percent of current open interest and 75000 lots
the all-contract gross participant cap is 150000 lots
the per-turn trade cap is 0.8 percent of the latest four-week average volume rescaled to a two-week turn
position limits step down to 15000 and then 8000 lots near expiry; expiry-month new trades are disabled
participant limits are enforced by the strategy execution owner and initial and maintenance margin are enforced by oil_futures_account_v1
the spot reference receives no participant-limit fields
no future weekly close, volume, open interest, or later annual macro state is used at a cutoff
no player state writes back to price, liquidity, global macro, or the commodity overlay
